name: NOLA Steele Fabrication and Erection
old_description: With more than 20 years in the industry, President Karen L. Williams founded NOLA Steele Fabrication and Erection LLC in 2014.
about:
NOLA Steele Fabrication and Erection LLC was founded in 2014 by Karen L. Williams in Harvey, Louisiana. Williams brought more than two decades of construction industry experience, having risen from office manager to vice president before launching her own firm. The company is certified as a woman-owned, service-disabled veteran-owned small business (SDVOSB), and also holds 8(a), DBE, MBE, WBE, and EDWOSB designations. Her husband, Travis Williams, a service-connected disabled veteran with 15 years in the U.S. Army, serves as vice president and estimator.

The company provides design, steel fabrication, structural steel erection, repair welding, ornamental iron, limited steel demolition, and miscellaneous steel work such as handrails, guardrails, balconies, and stair stringers. It also supplies steel products and furnishes skilled labor including welders, fitters, riggers, tackers, ironworkers, painters, and sandblasters. NOLA Steele operates with a team of about 35 trained professionals and has completed more than 500 projects since inception.

Clients include government agencies such as the U.S. Army Corps of Engineers and the Louis Armstrong New Orleans International Airport, as well as municipalities, nonprofit organizations, and commercial contractors throughout Southeast Louisiana.

Williams established the firm with a mission of superior quality, craftsmanship, and customer satisfaction, emphasizing a thorough quality control program and a vision to train and certify new welders. The company stresses that it is fully licensed, insured, and bonded, and aims to deliver projects on time and within budget.
